Analysts suggest long-term stock picks amid market volatility

Amidst market volatility driven by geopolitical tensions, crude oil prices, and foreign selling, analysts have identified nine stocks for long-term investment. These recommendations span various sectors including banking, telecommunications, consumer businesses, hospitals, and specialized manufacturing. Specific stocks mentioned include Bharti Airtel and Kotak Mahindra Bank, with analysts weighing in on the latter following Anup Saha's appointment.
